northStar: The Verdict Sheet — a lamp-lit page that states a finding at poster scale, then lets you audit it line by line.

gold.role: authority and proof only; never decorative

ink.role: the only ground; no light variant exists

strike.keyframes: from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0) } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0) }
strike.usage: The single authored moment: the generated verdict prints into the hero slot. Reused as a 1.4s travelling hairline for the analysing state. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

elevation.notes: Depth comes from tonal separation, hairline rules and type weight. A shadow anywhere breaks the system.

browserSurfaces.scrollbar: 10px, gold-deep thumb with a 3px ink border, gold on hover

rules: Colour is never the only channel: a cited row carries a gold bar, a heavier gold ID, and a gold wash.
Mono means measurement or identifier; prose is never mono.
More space above a heading than below it.
Tables use horizontal hairlines only — no vertical grid, no zebra, no container.
donts: No cards, tiles, or stat-tile rows
No second accent, no gradients, no gradient text
No kickers or eyebrows above headings
